## Experience (18+ years)
- 2025-11 — present: Waxbill Technologies, Head of backend development. Internal ERP system for the investment firm DST Global. Architecture, team, code. Stack: php 8.4, symfony 7.4, mysql, sphinx, redis, elasticsearch, docker.
- 2016-08 — 2025-10: PropellerAds, Principal web developer. Advertising network. Nine years on the SSP (self-service platform): from a PHP monolith to Go services. Scrum. Stack: go, php 8.3, symfony 6.4, postgresql, redis, docker, teamcity, capistrano.
- 2014-04 — 2016-08: Topface, Principal web developer. High-load social network. Monetization: A/B experiments, referral partner program, cohort analysis. Two internal hackathons. Stack: php 7, redis, zookeeper, elasticsearch, mysql, postgresql, docker.
- 2014-01 — 2014-04: TolkoTolk, Web developer, remote. Ad management for VKontakte, ad creation UI. Stack: zend framework 1.9, mysql.
- 2012-10 — 2013-10: FotoStrana, Principal web developer. High-load social network. Core and advertising: photo albums engine, “boards and pins”, advertising API. Stack: zend framework 1, mysql, svn.
- 2010-11 — 2012-10: Nash Rayon → Webcom, Web developer → principal. SMS billing: content sites and a statistics aggregator. Promoted to principal, team of 2. Scrum. Stack: zend framework 1, kohana 3, mysql, git.
- 2010-01 — 2010-09: WebDoka, Web developer. Web studio: sites from scratch, client support, specs. ZFConf 2010. Stack: zend framework 1, umi.cms, 1c-bitrix.
- 2008-12 — 2010-01: BeCost, Senior web developer. Auto parts e-commerce, logistics system (basis of the bachelor's thesis), HelpDesk, interviewing. Team of 4. Stack: zend framework 1, mysql, gentoo, seo.
- 2008-04 — 2008-08: SOLVO, Junior programmer, W2A system. Warehouse management systems: XML interfaces, Oracle views. Stack: oracle, rhel, cvs.
